shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'for f in app/*; do echo "FILE $f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc "git show HEAD:package.json && git status --short && rg -n \"cacheComponents|partial prerender|Suspense|dynamic\" node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render -g '*.js' | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('.next/server/app/index.html').read_text()
for value in ['Dashboard','Loading dashboard','Total Revenue','Latest Invoices']:
 print(value, value in s)
PY"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,220p' app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx && cat app/loading.tsx && cat next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY' from pathlib import Path s=Path('.next/server/app/index.html').read_text() for value in ['

Dashboard

', 'Total Revenue', 'Total Invoices', 'Revenue', 'Latest Invoices', 'Loading revenue...', 'Loading dashboard...']: print(f'{value}: {value in s}') PY"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && git diff --check'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from shutil import rmtree
build_dir = Path('/workspace/.next')
generated_types = Path('/workspace/next-env.d.ts')
if (build_dir / 'server/app/index.html').is_file():
    rmtree(build_dir)
if generated_types.is_file() and 'This file is automatically generated' in generated_types.read_text():
    generated_types.unlink()
PY"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && test ! -e .next && test ! -e next-env.d.ts && echo clean-build-artifacts'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/workspace/next-env.d.ts')
if p.is_file() and '/// <reference types=\"next\" />' in p.read_text() and '// NOTE: This file should not be edited' in p.read_text():
    p.unlink()
PY"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && test ! -e .next && test ! -e next-env.d.ts && echo build-artifacts-removed'
